learning_objective: 🎯 We will learn how to read the clock, understand hours and minutes, and organize our fun day!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A clock has a short hand for the hour and a long hand for the minute. When the long hand is on 12, it is exactly that hour, like 3 o'clock!
Some things take a long time, like sleeping at night. Some things happen very fast, like blinking our eyes or clapping our hands!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 My Daily Routine
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a big circle and make a clock face. Draw the hands to show what time you wake up, eat lunch, and go to play!

quick_recap: ⭐ The short hand tells us the hour and the long hand tells us the minute.
⭐ We use time to help us know when to do our daily activities.
